why.en: Describe quantities relative to a reference and calculate changes reliably.
why.zh-Hant: 以基準描述數量，並準確計算有向變化。

before: Compare whole numbers; add/subtract fractions and decimals; read equal number-line ticks.
topics.scope: Full unit target JS2.1–2.3, including number-line representation, comparison, mixed operations and contextual problems. Planned families are not completed coverage.
topics.boundary: No absolute-value notation or advanced index laws are required by this pilot; optional enrichment must be labelled. Avoid excessively complicated arithmetic.

takeaway.en: Use a clear reference, keep direction and magnitude separate, and check operations through inverse relationships.
takeaway.zh-Hant: 先定清楚基準，分清方向與大小，並用逆運算檢驗結果。

topics.next: Use directed values when interpreting algebraic expressions and solving equations.

why.en: Use symbols to describe a rule without losing its meaning.
why.zh-Hant: 用符號表達規律，並保留原來的意思。

before: Directed arithmetic; letters representing quantities; primary area formulae.
topics.scope: JS7.1–7.4: both directions of words/symbols, formulae including multiple variables, odd/even/square/triangular sequences, supplied general terms and preliminary input–processing–output.
topics.boundary: Like terms and polynomial expansion are unit 11 work, not the definition of completing unit 7. The P1 expansion fixture is not promoted to a unit-7 lesson. Multivariable formulas and open pattern reasoning require manual support; formal function definitions are deferred.

takeaway.en: Symbols express relationships: read them both ways, preserve grouping and distinguish an inferred pattern from a stated rule.
takeaway.zh-Hant: 符號表達關係：要能雙向理解、保留運算分組，並分清推測的規律與已知規則。

topics.next: Use a defined quantity and an expression on each side to formulate an equation.

why.en: Find an unknown by preserving an equality, then interpret what the value means.
why.zh-Hant: 在保持等式成立的過程中求未知數，並解釋所得數值。

before: Directed arithmetic; interpreting expressions; the primary balance principle.
topics.scope: JS8.1–8.3: meaning of a solution, solving a general one-unknown linear equation with one solution, formulating and solving contextual problems.
topics.boundary: The explanatory notes restrict this unit to exactly one solution. No-solution/infinitely-many cases are deferred, not silently included as challenge examples. Variable denominators, quadratic equations and unrestricted equation parsing are outside the pilot.

takeaway.en: Define the unknown, preserve equality, check the original relation and interpret the value in the situation.
takeaway.zh-Hant: 先定義未知數，保持等式成立，代回原式檢驗，再按情境解釋數值。

topics.next: Connect to linear equations in two unknowns; identities and exceptional cases need their own later objectives.

why.en: Use stated geometric facts to justify conclusions rather than trusting the appearance of a sketch.
why.zh-Hant: 根據已知幾何條件推論，並為結論提供理由。

before: Degree measure, straight/round/right angles; identify lines, vertices and rays; simple subtraction.
topics.scope: JS19.1–19.5: basic angles including complementary/supplementary; transversals/pairs; parallel tests and properties; triangle interior/exterior deductions and reasons.
topics.boundary: An angle-pair name does not require parallel lines. Equality properties do. Keep the given premise distinct from the desired conclusion; no unmarked parallel/right/equal assumptions. Triangle proof needs manual evidence.

takeaway.en: Name the angles, list what is given, choose a justified rule and state a reason for every new relationship.
takeaway.zh-Hant: 先辨認角、列出已知條件，再選用有根據的性質，為每個新關係說明理由。

topics.next: Use these deductions in polygons and triangle congruence/similarity after their own scope review.
